scope: Actual full-vector finite-height 3D guided-mode 2x2 complex S-matrix. This is not a spatial-convergence or commercial-agreement certificate.
implementation: Independent signed-k native unit-power mode projections for each propagation direction, each anchored to positive-real center Ey. Four measured reference/device stages, physical port planes and propagation phase retained.

ports.basis: One Ey-dominant guided mode per lead, evaluated at each frequency; squared amplitude is modal power
ports.phase_convention: DFT exp(+i omega t); forward propagation exp(+i beta x); center Ey is real positive at each physical port; both directions use the same transverse E orientation
ports.mode_gauge: Positive-real Ey at the core center at each physical plane; independent +k and -k modes for the two propagation directions
ports.normalization: Direction-specific unit-power MPB coefficients on the Meep Yee integration grid; outgoing device coefficients divided by matching measured incident reference coefficients
ports.reference_planes: Physical monitor planes; propagation phase retained; no reference-through division or de-embedding

shifted_physical_planes.observation: Both port planes move outward by 0.25 µm; S keeps the measured propagation phase. Comparison against MPB beta is a diagnostic of finite-grid FDTD dispersion, not a calibrated correction.

straight_phase_against_mpb.interpretation: MPB solves a continuum modal eigenproblem for the sampled material cross-section; FDTD has finite spatial/time dispersion. Nonzero discrepancy is retained and prevents a convergence claim.

numerical_regression_tests.result: 2 tests passed against retained actual runs; the numerical runtime was Meep 1.35.0.
checks: Explicit target and schema rejection before Meep import
Complex S equals saved outgoing divided by measured reference incident amplitude
Straight near-zero reflection and near-unity transmitted power
Mirror-symmetric gap reflection and reciprocal transmission within 2e-4 complex amplitude
Actual finite-height material and Ex/Ey/Ez volume coordinates
Native raw complex monitor fields and independent signed-k modal evidence
Forced early stop retains raw coefficients while invalidating all spectral bins

corrected_diagnostic.problem: Using the opposite-going coefficient from a single +k sampled mode gave unequal modal reflections for an x-mirror-symmetric device, despite matched total reflected flux.
corrected_diagnostic.independent_raw_flux_audit: Native saved Meep E/H were reloaded into matching monitors. Reflected total-flux ratios from both directions agreed to approximately 1e-7; the normalization/gauge problem was isolated to mode projection.
corrected_diagnostic.correction: Solve the actual +k and -k MPB modes separately; select the matching propagation-direction coefficient and canonicalize each with its own center-Ey phase anchor. No fitted amplitude, matrix symmetrization or phase offset.
corrected_diagnostic.fresh_run_validation: All reported final cases execute the corrected adapter from a fresh numerical process. Earlier raw fields and prototype records remain local, clearly separate from final qualification.

reproduction.supported_cases: Save a case config as JSON and run .venv/bin/python scripts/run_simulation.py CONFIG.json --output NEW_DIRECTORY with the recorded Meep environment.
reproduction.negative_case: gap-timeout deliberately uses 5 fs after source turn-off, below the GUI minimum; call backend.adapters.meep_ports3d_adapter.run directly in a fresh Meep interpreter.
reproduction.numerical_tests: PHOTONICS_MEEP_PORTS3D_EVIDENCE_DIR=.local/ports3d-meep .local/meep-conda/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_meep_ports3d_adapter -v validates these retained actual runs; omitting the variable runs the numerical cases anew.
